name: Ultra — N64 & Dreamcast emulator
description: A multi-console emulator in the browser: a MIPS R4300i core for the Nintendo 64 (big-endian RDRAM, RGBA5551 VI) and a Hitachi SH-4 core for the Sega Dreamcast (little-endian RAM, RGB565 PowerVR framebuffer, active-low Maple pad), each with its own in-engine assembler, disassembler, ROM/disc identification and homebrew demo cartridges.
